clues.text: In Egypt, Aaron struck the dust of the earth with his staff, and the dust turned into these.
In Egypt, this plague came upon both man and beast and stayed on them.
Pharaoh's magicians tried to make these with their magic arts, but for the first time they could not.
After this plague, Pharaoh's own magicians told him, "This is the finger of God."
In Egypt, this plague came right after dead frogs were piled in stinking heaps across the land.
After this plague in Egypt, God warned Pharaoh through Moses that swarms of flies would come next.
Isaiah says the heavens will vanish like smoke and the earth's people will die like these.
